metadata.subtitle: IV. Fugue in C-sharp minor
metadata.instrument: Five independent voices - piano realization - Draft 1
metadata.description: Original authored subject, countersubject, episodes and form; constraint-assisted supporting counterpoint.

editorial_revisions.reason: Hold D-sharp across the tenor answer, avoiding a direct outer octave while the bass is silent.

rhythmic_refinement.method: Free upper-part edits admitted individually by event and contextual audits; authored notes immutable.

manual_review.reason: Another voice anticipated the resolution. Restore the original onset for cleaner strict-style counterpoint; retain the five prepared suspensions whose delayed resolution is not duplicated (9-8 conventional doubling excepted).
